top_signals.title: Belarus Refineries Post Decade-High Profits Amid Russia's Fuel Crisis
top_signals.summary: Belarusian oil refineries recorded their highest profitability in a decade in 2026, according to the independent Pozirk news agency, as Russia's refining crisis pushed record volumes of gasoline and diesel across the border. Belneftekhim head Ilya Ikan credited the results to "favorable conditions in foreign markets, primarily in the eastern direction," adding that reserve capacity came online for round-the-clock operations in June and July. Belarusian gasoline shipments to Russia rose 25-fold over the first seven months of 2026 compared with the…

top_signals.title: India Cumulative Monsoon Rainfall 15% Below Normal as of Sept. 9
top_signals.summary: India has so far received 648 millimeters of rainfall during the monsoon season, which runs from June through September, compared with an average of 760.6 millimeters, according to data published by the India Meteorological Department on Sept. 9.
